title: Bug Bar — impact rating reference
description: Four-dimensional impact rubric (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Safety) for embedded OT field devices, after Fockel et al. / Phoenix Contact. Rate each affected dimension 1-5 using the worked scenarios; the threat impact is the maximum across dimensions. Edit this file (it lives in the shared knowledge base) to adapt the scenarios to your product class; commit and share it so a whole department rates consistently.
rule: Impact = max(Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Safety) for the worst plausible affected asset. Safety dominates where a safety case is binding.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.scenario: Only non-sensitive data exposed (e.g. device model, firmware version).

levels.label: Minor
levels.scenario: Local configuration or diagnostic data exposed; no credentials or process secrets.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.scenario: Process values or measurement history exposed; limited business-sensitive disclosure.

levels.label: Major
levels.scenario: Commissioning credentials, keys or recipe/parameter sets exposed for one device.

levels.label: Severe
levels.scenario: Fleet-wide key material or a shared secret exposed, enabling mass compromise.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.scenario: Cosmetic or self-correcting change; no effect on measurement or control.

levels.label: Minor
levels.scenario: Bounded, detectable parameter change that operators readily notice and revert.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.scenario: Measurement value or configuration falsified within plausible range; process disturbance.

levels.label: Major
levels.scenario: Undetected falsification that can defeat a protection function on one site; firmware tamper.

levels.label: Severe
levels.scenario: Persistent, undetectable manipulation (e.g. signed-update bypass) deployable across the fleet.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.scenario: Momentary glitch; device self-recovers with no operational effect.

levels.label: Minor
levels.scenario: Single device needs a manual restart; fail-safe value reported meanwhile.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.scenario: Loss of measurement/view for one device for an extended period; manual workaround needed.

levels.label: Major
levels.scenario: Repeated or fleet-affecting outage; loss of view of a protection-relevant function.

levels.label: Severe
levels.scenario: Sustained denial of a safety-relevant function that forces a hazardous plant state.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.scenario: No credible path to any safety effect.

levels.label: Minor
levels.scenario: Theoretical safety relevance only; multiple independent barriers remain.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.scenario: Contributes to a hazard only in combination with another independent failure.

levels.label: Major
levels.scenario: Can demote or disable a protection function (e.g. SIL demotion); harm possible on one site.

levels.label: Severe
levels.scenario: Directly enables a safety hazard (overfill, spill, fire) with environmental or human harm; fleet-wide.
